$comment: Corrections log. Empty by design, not by omission: the schema exists so that a correction is a row, not an apology thread. We will not populate it with hypothetical corrections.

schema.published_on: date the wrong statement went live
schema.what_is_true: the replacement, with a source id
schema.how_we_found_out: reader | gate | source update | account report

rule: A correction is published within one working day of confirmation and the guide carries a visible note. Silence is the only unacceptable option.
